flags.why: The entry omits the everyday Southern meaning ‘burned; scalded’, as in ‘bị phỏng nước sôi’ ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Ph%E1%BB%8Fng)).
flags.fix: Add: adj [Southern] | burned; scalded. Example: Tôi bị phỏng nước sôi. = I was scalded by boiling water.

flags.why: ‘Tố’ means to expose or report wrongdoing, rather than to sue someone in court ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/T%E1%BB%91)).
‘Vờ’ does not mean floating plant debris; its noun meaning is ‘mayfly’ ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/V%E1%BB%9D)).
